summary: Add the pure decide function and compact rule
description: Add decide(usage, config) in the rule engine. FR-C2-01, FR-C2-02, FR-C2-05, and FR-C2-06. It returns action, reason, tokens_saved_est, and messages. It performs no I/O. compact_recommended only reports. It does not summarize.
scope: Return action none below the compact threshold
Return compact_recommended at or above the threshold
Read the threshold from config, not a hardcoded branch only
acceptanceCriteria: decide(usage, config) returns action, reason, tokens_saved_est, and messages. context_pct 0.59 with default config returns none and reason below_threshold. context_pct 0.60 returns compact_recommended, reason context_pct>=compact_threshold, tokens_saved_est 0. A config threshold of 0.80 keeps 0.70 at none. No file or HTTP call runs. FR-C2-01 FR-C2-02 FR-C2-05 FR-C2-06.
